findings.finding: Current page calls 71,818 'families', while the FY2024-25 report page 23 calls 71,818 students. Preserve different units; do not reconcile by equality of number.
Live page mixes 2021 attendance, a Year-12-2022 cohort measured 2.5 years later, and a 2022-23 footnote. Retrieval time is not claim measurement time.
90% student2student reading improvement is followed by a footnote naming Learning Clubs outcomes; source linkage needs verification before treating as audited impact.

defects: D20: Real source-native unit discrepancy: families versus students.
D20b: Outcome footnotes and temporal labels are not consistently aligned on the live HTML page.
counterexamples: A fresh HTML capture can contain older and inconsistently attributed claims.
